limitations: All 104 listed originals were individually viewed; screenshot contents, not DOM geometry, determine findings.
Raw X11 black area outside the 1100×760 or 760×520 application window is unused desktop canvas.
Root, matrix and footnote targets are fully visible in all 16 combinations; narrow200 footnote definition wraps but remains complete.

Many flow/sequence targets and all pie target screenshots show only part of the diagram at their current scroll positions. Pie legend right-hand content is outside the internal viewport at narrow150 and wide/narrow200.
No blank target SVG or missing target preview was observed in these 96 X11 images. This is not a claim that every whole diagram is visible simultaneously.

Independent real-wheel edge/legend reachability was separately inspected in candidate11-pixel-review-reachability.json; static matrix partial views do not replace that evidence or erase prior candidate10 failures.
No UI actions, tests, builds, product/test changes, original-image modifications or heavy image processing were performed for this review.
